packageRules.description: One PR per dependency. config:recommended pulls in grouping presets (group:recommended, group:monorepos) that bundle related packages together; clearing groupName/groupSlug for everything undoes that.

Expo owns these versions. They are pinned by the installed SDK and must only ever move together, via `npx expo install --fix` during a deliberate SDK upgrade. Bumping any of them individually produces a version set Expo does not support. Derived from expo's bundledNativeModules.json, plus typescript and @types/react which `expo install --fix` also pins.
